verdict_text:
YES

The script performs the required pre-merge equality check on all non-MLP tensors across base/ft1/ft2 (via `torch.equal` in a loop keyed by the same MLP regex), computes each of the 64 MLP tensors in float32 against the unmodified `base` (avoiding the ordering hazard) and casts back to the base dtype, copies all other tensors unchanged from `base`, and asserts `merged == 64` and `len(out) == 244` before writing `out/T4/model.safetensors`. All three required checks are present as loud failures (`assert`), and the arithmetic and output structure match the spec exactly.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
